description: This script automates downloading specific files from GitHub repositories at different versions, compares their contents, and verifies that certain stripped versions contain only deletions. It serves as a documentation and automation tool for managing versioned source files related to Node.js internal modules.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a specific version of a file from the Node.js GitHub repository and saves it locally with a version-specific filename.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares the local version of a file with a raw source from the distribution folder to detect differences.

methods.name: assertStrippedIsOnlyDeletions
methods.description: Asserts that the diff between a file and its stripped version contains only deletions, ensuring no other changes are present.
